info.title: OpenStatusPage API
info.description:
HTTP API of OpenStatusPage, a self-hosted status page. Follows [JSON:API 1.1](https://jsonapi.org/format/1.1/): every JSON:API answer is `application/vnd.api+json` with `"jsonapi": { "version": "1.1" }`; request bodies must use that media type. A few endpoints keep other formats (health, feeds, images, OIDC redirects) and say so.

Errors are always JSON:API error documents. Collections take `page[number]`/`page[size]` and the `filter[...]` parameters listed per operation; `include` only where listed; `sort` nowhere (`400`). Ids are generated by the server.

Authentication: the management API takes the session cookie (with `X-Requested-With: openstatuspage` on mutating requests) or an API token (`Authorization: Bearer osp_…`). Operations list the role they need (`x-required-role`).

The reference with examples is docs/api.md in the repository.

get.description: Liveness and readiness probe: answers once the database answers. Exists in every role; not JSON:API.

Anonymous requests and instances with `APP_ROLE=public` get the public part (public read API, private pages, subscriptions, feeds and images). A signed-in user or an API token on an `admin` or `all` instance gets the whole API. When the page does not publish its API description (setting `publicApiDescription` off), every request that would get the public part is answered with `404`; signed-in users and API tokens still get the whole API. Revalidate with `If-None-Match`.

The page settings plus what the pages derive from the database (`PublicSiteExtras`, packages/shared/src/site-pages.ts): `pages` (published pages for the navigation and the footer), `logoSize` and `theme`, the active theme as `{ id, stylesheets }` with the same-origin stylesheet URLs `/theme/<hash>.css` (tokens first, then the extra CSS). `accentColor` is the accent in effect: the override of the settings, or the light accent of the active theme.

get.description:
Named by the SHA-256 of its bytes: cached for a year as immutable, with an `ETag` (`304` for `If-None-Match`), `Content-Disposition: inline` and a CSP that allows nothing.

Rate limit: 600 requests per minute and client IP address.

get.summary: A stylesheet of the active theme
get.description:
The tokens of the active theme as CSS custom properties, or its extra CSS; the URLs are in `theme.stylesheets` of `GET /api/public/settings`. Named by a hash of the content: cached for a year as immutable, with an `ETag` (`304` for `If-None-Match`) and `nosniff`. A preview stylesheet (a theme that is not active, `?theme=<id>` on a public page) is only answered to a signed-in admin (session cookie) on an `admin` or `all` instance, with `Cache-Control: private, no-store` and without `304`; anything else is `404`.

Rate limit: 600 requests per minute and client IP address.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: `<hash>.css`: the first 20 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the stylesheet.

**Admin only** (role `admin`).

delete.description:
Uploaded themes only: `409` for built-in and folder themes and for the active theme. `?uploadedCopy=true` deletes the uploaded theme that a folder theme with the same id hides (`404` when there is none).

**Admin only** (role `admin`).

parameters.name: uploadedCopy
parameters.description: `true`: delete the uploaded theme hidden by a folder theme with this id (`400` for other values).

post.description:
Makes it the theme of the public pages. A theme that fails WCAG 2.2 AA (with the accent override of the settings) is `409` with code `contrast_failures` (the failed checks in `meta.failures`) unless `acceptContrastFailures` is `true`; activating the active theme again with `true` confirms a failure nobody confirmed (`contrastUnconfirmed`). Written to the audit log.

**Admin only** (role `admin`).

id.description: Must match the id in the URL.

get.description:
The theme file as a download (`Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="<id>.json"`, `Cache-Control: no-store`); not JSON:API.

**Admin only** (role `admin`).

get.summary: Download the extra CSS of a theme
get.description:
As a download (`Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="<id>.css"`, `Cache-Control: no-store`); `404` for a theme without extra CSS. Not JSON:API.

**Admin only** (role `admin`).

post.description:
Works for every source type. Numeric states: 0=ok, 1=warning, 2=critical, 3=unknown. `full: true` (remove checks missing from the payload) only for sources of type `webhook`; a full push that would remove more than half of the used checks is `409`. Source, token and rate limit are checked before the body is read.

Rate limit: 120 requests per minute and monitoring source.

Bodies up to 5 MiB.

requestBody.description: The generic payload (JSON sent as `text/plain` is accepted, too).

post.description:
The native payload of a monitoring system: the Uptime Kuma webhook notification, the bundled Icinga 2 notification script or the bundled openITCockpit notification command (see docs/adapters).

Rate limit: 120 requests per minute and monitoring source.

Bodies up to 5 MiB.
